findings.label: Silent detail-less VALIDATION_ERROR on the task form
findings.detail: toastUnlessInline (create-task-view.tsx) skips every VALIDATION_ERROR, but applyApiErrorToForm maps nothing when details are absent (error-handler.ts body-parser fallback, generic P2003), so the user gets no feedback. Toast whenever applyApiErrorToForm returns false, as CreateEmployeeDialog already does.

findings.label: Assignee label without a target
findings.detail: task-form.tsx AssigneeField renders FieldLabel htmlFor={id} in all states, but the id exists only on the SelectTrigger. While loading, on error or with no employees, the label is orphaned. Give the placeholder/message that id, or use a non-label heading in those states.

findings.label: API 400 details to field mapping untested in the browser
findings.detail: Only form-errors.test.ts covers it. Add one e2e case (e.g. page.route returning a 400 with details), or record in chunk D that unit coverage is accepted.

findings.label: Edit-save TASK_COMPLETED/404 races untested
findings.detail: The toast, refetch and navigate path in EditTaskView has no e2e. Cover it like the stale approve: approve or delete via the API, then click Save.

findings.label: Detail-page delete untested
findings.detail: Only the row-menu delete is exercised. Add an e2e case for Delete on /admin/tasks/[id] (navigates to /admin/tasks, then removes the cached detail).

findings.label: Priority filter has no e2e assertion
findings.detail: Add one assertion that choosing High puts priority=HIGH in the URL and filters the rows.
